outcome: Carbohydrate metabolism (fasting glucose, fasting insulin, HOMA-IR)
cohort: The study included 69 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus and 71 pregnant women with normal glucose tolerance.
finding: Serum WISP1 concentrations and WISP1 mRNA and protein expression in placenta and abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue were significantly higher in women with GDM compared to controls, and WISP1 levels were positively associated with BMI, fasting glucose, fasting insulin, HOMA-IR, and IL-6 levels.
cross-section timing: Fasting sera were collected between 25 and 30 weeks of gestation; tissue samples were obtained from women who had undergone cesarean section.
